task_context.problem_statement: Joe played catch with Derek and Tammy. He caught the ball 23 times. Derek made four less than double the catches Joe did. Tammy caught the ball sixteen more than a third of the times Derek did. How many times did Tammy catch the ball?
task_context.reference_solution:
Derek caught the ball 2 * 23 - 4 = 46 - 4 = <<2*23-4=42>>42 times.
Tammy caught the ball 42 / 3 + 16 = 14 + 16 = <<42/3+16=30>>30 times.
#### 30
